product_js.title: Personalized Baseball Bedding Full Size Flag Custom Name D - Design 05
product_js.description:
Elevate your bedroom with a personalized touch with this custom baseball comforter set from Jeminise. Designed for baseball enthusiasts, this comfortable and durable bedding set is perfect for adding a sporty flair to any room, celebrating your passion for the game.

Key Features

  • Meaningful Design: Celebrate your love for baseball with this unique and personalized bedding set, perfect for players and fans.
  • Available Sizes: Choose from US Twin (68" x 88"), US Full (78" x 88"), US Queen (88" x 88"), and US King (104" x 88") to fit your bed perfectly.
  • Material Details: Crafted from 100% brushed polyester fabric, offering a soft, comfy, durable, and lightweight feel. Features whole-piece microfiber filling with tight stitching to prevent clumping.
  • Superior Manufacturing: Utilizes environmental protection techniques in the finishing process to ensure dye retention and prevent fading, with smooth, fine, and compact stitching.
  • Easy Care: Machine washable; wash separately in cold water and air dry without heat for best results. Microfiber dries quickly and becomes fluffier.
  • Customization: Features text input options for personalization, allowing you to add a unique touch.
  • Included Components: This set includes a duvet cover, providing a complete and stylish bedding solution.

Product Specifications

Brand Jeminise
Product Type Duvet Cover Set
Material Polyester
Fabric Type Polyester, Cotton
Color Baseball Thunder
Pattern Baseball
Set Name Personalized Baseball Bedding Set
Selected Size Multiple Size
Customization 2 text inputs
Thread Count 400
Included Components Duvet Cover
Special Feature Breathable
Seasons All
Care Instructions Machine Wash
